items.title: Home branch and check-in records are stored
items.description_md:
As the gym owner, I want every member to have a home branch and every check-in to be stored with its branch, date and time so that I know where and when members come in.

The branch list is exactly the 3 FitZone branches. Check-in at any branch per A-018.

user_story.i_want: every member to have a home branch and every check-in to be stored with its branch, date and time
user_story.so_that: I know where and when members come in

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a person signing up chooses "Kothrud" as home branch (one of the 3 branches), When the member is created, Then the member's record shows "Kothrud" as home branch.

Given a member whose home branch is Kothrud, When staff at another branch check that member in at 18:30 on 12 Jan 2027, Then the stored check-in has the member, that other branch, the date 12 Jan 2027 and the time 18:30.
Given a person signing up, When they try to finish without choosing a home branch, Then the system refuses and asks for a home branch.

definition_of_done: Code reviewed by one other engineer
Unit and integration tests pass in CI
components: MOD-01 Platform and foundation: responsive English web app, branch data model, release plan

Make sure the created member stores home_branch_id and that cmp-checkin record_checkin stores the staff user's branch, the member id and the timestamp in ent-checkin. Add unit tests for these rules.

WHEN a front desk user of branch B records a check-in for a member whose home branch is A THE SYSTEM SHALL store a check-in with member, branch B, and the time in UTC that converts to the India date and time of the check-in
